Headline          Doc re: GE files Form 8-K

On September 8, 2026, General Electric Company (the "Company") filed a Form 8-K with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission ("SEC"), which has been submitted to RNS.  It is also available on the SEC's website at http://www.sec.gov and on the Company's website at https://www.geaerospace.com/investor-relations/sec-filings .
